# Neural_Avalanche

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A cascade of neural activity events that follows a power-law size distribution, characteristic of critical-state dynamics in neuronal networks. Understanding and replicating neural avalanches in neuromorphic hardware could enable robust, energy-efficient, and biologically plausible computation.
